detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

BPC-157

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C62H98N16O22
  • Molecular Weight: ~1419.5 g/mol
  • Sequence: Gly-Glu-Pro-Pro-Pro-Gly-Lys-Pro-Ala-Asp-Asp-Ala-Gly-Leu-Val
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

BPC-157 is a synthetic pentadecapeptide consisting of a defined 15-amino-acid sequence. It is studied in laboratory environments for its biochemical properties and peptide signaling behavior. This product is supplied as a pre-formulated aqueous research solution, designed to provide consistency and stability for controlled research applications.

Research Applications:
  • Investigation of peptide stability and signaling behavior in vitro
  • Study of peptide interactions within cellular and biochemical models
  • Evaluation of peptide transport and degradation under laboratory conditions
  • Comparative research involving short-chain regulatory peptides
Storage and Handling:
  • For optimal stability, store sealed product in a cool, dark, and dry environment. Refrigeration at 2–8 °C is recommended after first puncture or once the seal has been compromised
  • Do not freeze
  • Protect from light
  • Maintain sterile handling practices during research use
Product Specifications:
  • Formulation: Aqueous solution
  • Concentration: 1 mg/mL
  • Total Content: 30 mg per bottle
  • Delivery Format: Metered liquid solution
  • Dispenses per Container: ~200
  • Amount per Dispense: ~150 mcg
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications.
Compliance Notice:

BPC-157 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
